title: How to Prepare a Salary Slip in Pakistan
description: What a salary slip should show, how to work out gross pay, deductions and net pay, and the mistakes to avoid. With a worked example.
lead: What a salary slip should show, how to work out gross pay, deductions and net pay, and the mistakes to avoid. With a worked example.
body:
A salary slip tells an employee exactly how their pay was worked out. It also protects the employer, because it is a record of what was paid. The layout is simple. The hard part is getting the deductions right, and those depend on rules that change.

What to put on it

  • Employer name and address, employee name, designation, and the month.
  • Basic salary and each allowance as separate lines.
  • Any overtime, bonus or arrears for the month.
  • Gross pay: the total of all earnings.
  • Each deduction as a separate line.
  • Net pay: gross pay minus deductions, and how it was paid.

The arithmetic

Gross pay = basic + allowances + overtime and bonus.
Net pay = gross pay - total deductions.

Example: Basic Rs. 60,000, house rent allowance Rs. 20,000 and transport Rs. 5,000 make a gross of Rs. 85,000. An advance recovery of Rs. 5,000 and other deductions of Rs. 8,000 give net pay of Rs. 72,000.

Deductions

Common deductions are income tax withheld from salary, recovery of advances or loans, and contributions that apply to your employees. The rates, slabs and limits change often, so they are not listed here. Take the current figures from FBR and the relevant authority, or from your payroll adviser, and do not copy last year's.

Common mistakes

  • Showing only the net amount with no breakdown.
  • Lumping allowances into one line.
  • Using last year's tax or contribution figures.
  • Deducting without telling the employee what for.
  • Not keeping a copy. Keep slips for every employee and month.
